blocks.text: Communicating results and conclusions is an important step in data analysis and research. It helps readers understand what the data shows and what decisions can be made. Clear communication ensures that results are not misunderstood or misused. Researchers must explain findings in a simple and logical manner. Conclusions should be based strictly on analyzed data. Proper communication improves transparency and credibility. Effective reporting also supports future research and decision-making.
